name: IT Helpdesk - Create Ticket

parameters.query: INSERT INTO hd_tickets (tenant_id, title, description, category, priority, requester_id, status, sla_deadline, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'OPEN', NOW() + CASE $5 WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN INTERVAL '4 hours' WHEN 'HIGH' THEN INTERVAL '8 hours' WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN INTERVAL '24 hours' ELSE INTERVAL '72 hours' END, NOW()) RETURNING id, sla_deadline;

SELECT u.username, u.mattermost_user_id FROM hd_agents u WHERE u.tenant_id = $1 AND u.is_available = true AND u.category_expertise @> ARRAY[$2]::text[] ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hd_tickets WHERE assigned_to = u.username AND status = 'OPEN') ASC LIMIT 1;
UPDATE hd_tickets SET assigned_to = $1 WHERE id = $2;

parameters.responseBody: ={"success": true, "ticket_id": "{{$('Create Ticket with SLA').item.json.id}}", "sla_deadline": "{{$('Create Ticket with SLA').item.json.sla_deadline}}"}
